meta.themes: Agent Platforms, AI for Science, AI Policy, Enterprise AI

news.title: OpenAI launched the OpenAI Partner Network
news.summary: OpenAI introduced a $150 million Partner Network to certify and enable about 300,000 consultants and partners, including Accenture, Bain, BCG, McKinsey, and PwC, to build and deliver AI solutions.

news.title: AI CEOs pitched G7 leaders on a global standards forum
news.summary: At the G7 summit in France, leaders of OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta pitched world leaders on an international forum to set standards for advanced AI models, with Canada's Mark Carney likening it to the Financial Stability Board.

news.title: Anthropic opened a Seoul office
news.summary: Anthropic opened a Seoul office and announced new partnerships across the Korean AI ecosystem.

news.title: Microsoft Work IQ APIs reached general availability
news.summary: Microsoft's Work IQ APIs became generally available, giving agents a context layer over Microsoft 365 data through Chat, Context, Tools, and Workspaces domains exposed via A2A, MCP, and REST.

news.title: Grok 4.3 became available on Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: xAI's Grok 4.3, with a 1-million-token context window, launched on Amazon Bedrock, marking xAI's debut as a model provider on the platform and running on Amazon's new Mantle inference engine.

news.title: HPE and NVIDIA moved agentic AI into production at HPE Discover
news.summary: At HPE Discover, HPE expanded its AI Factory with NVIDIA to take agentic AI into production, adding the NVIDIA Vera CPU, NVIDIA Agent Toolkit, and confidential computing for security, governance, and sovereignty.

news.title: OpenAI introduced LifeSciBench
news.summary: OpenAI released LifeSciBench, a benchmark that grades AI models on real life-science research tasks using expert-written rubrics.

news.title: OpenAI showed a near-autonomous AI chemist improving a drug-discovery reaction
news.summary: OpenAI detailed a near-autonomous workflow in which GPT-5.4 paired with Molecule.one's Maria proposed and ran thousands of wet-lab reactions, raising the mean yield of a difficult Chan-Lam coupling from 16.6% to 25.2% over two cycles.

news.title: OpenAI detailed predicting model behavior before release
news.summary: OpenAI described a method to forecast how a model will behave before launch by simulating deployment, analyzing about 1.3 million de-identified conversations across GPT-5 Thinking through GPT-5.4.

news.title: Google unveiled a Gemini-powered Google Home Speaker
news.summary: Google introduced the Google Home Speaker built for its Gemini for Home assistant, opening pre-orders at $99.99 ahead of a June 25 ship date.

news.title: Snowflake spotlighted new AI releases at its June AI Pulse
news.summary: Snowflake used its June AI Pulse sessions to showcase new AI product releases and implementation guidance for enterprise data teams.

news.title: AI led the week's biggest venture funding rounds
news.summary: AI dominated the week's largest venture rounds, including a $500 million raise for AI networking developer Nexthop AI and $125 million for agentic-AI cybersecurity startup Kai.
